autotune_cache_write_timing.bearing_on_H1: presence and bracketing only. This is exactly why H1 needs the direct autotune-OFF discriminator rather than an inference from cache timestamps.
autotune_cache_write_timing.interpretation: the span is NOT a measure of autotune duration. It is dominated by a single 196.4 s interval with no autotune writes at all, and the writes fall into two clusters. What happened inside that gap is UNATTRIBUTED: it could be one expensive autotuning whose results were flushed at the end, or non-autotune compile work. Both are consistent with these mtimes, so neither is claimed.

exclusive_attribution.SCOPE: this is the WARM Stage 2 process (~20 s of compile), NOT the cold >601.4 s Stage 1 compile. The family shares below describe the warm process only and are NOT evidence about the cold compile. Per standing manager instruction the two must not be equated.
exclusive_attribution.bearing_on_H1: NONE for the cold compile. Worth recording that in the WARM process autotune is 2.70% of compile while codegen is 70.10% -- but a warm process skips exactly the work H1 is about, so this neither supports nor undermines it.

cross_check.outcome: PASSED on every range (a failure raises and blocks this object)

exclusive_attribution.method: exclusive (self) time: duration minus direct children. Inclusive nvtx_sum durations are NOT used, because nesting would double-count. Thunk execution is excluded from the compile denominator.
exclusive_attribution.reason: 100.0% of exclusive compile time attributed to named families

h1_rule.why_feasible: only the autotune-OFF arm is measured, and it is bounded by construction. The autotune-ON compile is never required to finish.

purpose: proves the Step 1 measurement chain works, using evidence already on disk. CPU-only. No GPU was requested, coordinated, imported or touched.

reproduce.note: no number in this object is hand-written; rerun the command to regenerate

xla_flag_preflight.method: exact-line match of the flag name in the binary's string table
xla_flag_preflight.why: a Step 1 that dies on an unknown flag inside a coordinated GPU window spends the window for nothing, which is how W1 attempt 1 was lost
